## 1.0.0 (2026-10-23)

### ✨ New Features

* add bottom nav, header tab, Leagues tab and Scorecast toggles ([16d97ec](https://github.com/nm-nvan/Neil-Morphe-Patches/commit/16d97ecbfd0c9e9787ec1bed21da23da8ea09bd2))
* add Morphe Settings screen with league chips toggle ([022ae6a](https://github.com/nm-nvan/Neil-Morphe-Patches/commit/022ae6a15a6e4161042e6ab9e2411cd94bd7c712))
* add theScore ad removal patches ([1699667](https://github.com/nm-nvan/Neil-Morphe-Patches/commit/169966715793ed54207ecc54934ccbd19556bf59))
* replace element ad patches with a single Remove ads patch ([2522a30](https://github.com/nm-nvan/Neil-Morphe-Patches/commit/2522a30b92c0299639bbd560ecb7e810d16afbfe))

patches.name: Hide Leagues tab sections
patches.description: Adds options in Morphe Settings to hide the league chips and the Spotlight section on the Leagues tab.

patches.name: Hide Scorecast blocks
patches.description: Adds options in Morphe Settings to hide blocks on a game's Scorecast tab, such as Game News and Odds.

patches.name: Hide bottom navigation tabs
patches.description: Adds options in Morphe Settings to hide the News, Scores, Favorites and Bet tabs. Leagues is always shown.

patches.name: Hide game and league tabs
patches.description: Adds options in Morphe Settings to hide individual top tabs on game and league screens.

patches.name: Keep classic game screen
patches.description: Adds an option in Morphe Settings (on by default) to keep the classic game screen if theScore turns on its redesigned one, so the game tab and Scorecast patches keep working.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes ads everywhere: the startup splash, banners and large ads on every screen, sponsor ads, full-screen ads and video ads.
